content: Hessafe guye GODAY Muses, «Beya; tani nena Gibxe kawaas Xoossa mala ooththadis; ne isha Aarooney ne doona gididi ne gishshas haasayana;
tani nena azazidayssa ubbaa ne isha Aaroones yootandassa; kawozi Isra7eele nayta ba biittafe kessi yeddana mala izi yootana.
Gido attiin tani kawoza wozina minththana; tani Gibxe biittan ta malaatanne maalalissiza miish darsa ooththikokka,
izi intte yootizayssa siyenna. He wode tani ta kushe Gibxe asaa bolla denththana; tani ta dereta Isra7eele nayta wolqqama pirdan Gibxeppe kessana.
Qasse Gibxeti tani ta qese Gibxe asaa bolla denththada Isra7eele nayta istta giddofe kessiza wode tani GODAA gididayssa istti erana» gides.
Museynne Aarooney GODAY istta azazida mala ooththida.
Istti kawozas yootiza wode Muses layththay osppun tamma; Aarooney qasse 83 layththa asa.
Aaroone Guufey Shoosh Gideth
GODAY Musenne Aaroone,
«Kawoy inttena, ‹Ane malaata tana bessite› giikko neni Aaroone, ‹Ne guufaa ekkada kawoza sinththan yegga› ga; histtiko izi shoosh gidana» gides.
Histtiin Museynne Aarooney kawozaakko gelidi GODAY istta azazida mala ooththida; Aarooney ba guufe kawoza sinththaninne daannata sinththan yeggiin guufezi shoosh gidides.
Hessafe guye kawozi daro eranchchatanne bitizayta xeygisiin Gibxe dere marotikka ba deren hessaththo ooththida.
Istti wurikka ba guufe guufe gaden yeggiin guufeti wurikka shoosh gidida shin Aaroone guufeya istta guufeta ubbaa mittadus.
Gidikkoka GODAY yootida mala kawoza wozinay minnida gishshas izi istta yo7o siyontta ixxides.
Haaththay Suuththan Laameteth
GODAY Muses, «Kawoza wozinay muumiin asaa izi yeddontta ixxida gishshas,
kawozi shaafa biza wode maaladora neni izakko baada izara gaaggana mala Abbaye shaafaa doonan eqqa; hee bashe shooshshan laamettida guufeza oykka ekkada ba.
Neni iza, ‹GODAA Ibraaweta Xoossay nena, «Bazzon taas goynnana mala ta asaa yedda» giidi tana neekko kiittides shin hanno gakkanaas neni ero gabeekka.
GODAY, «Tani GODAA gididayssa neni hayssan erana» gides. Tani Abbaye shaafa haaththaa ta kushen diza guufezan shocikko haaththay suuththan laamettana.
Abbaye shaafaa moleykka hayqqana; shaafaykka xinqqana; Gibxeti he shaafa haaththaa uyanaas dandayettenna› gaada yoota» gides.

GODAY Muses, «Neni Aaroones, ‹Ne guufe oykkada Gibxe haaththata bolla, shaafata bolla, zara haaththata bollanne eellida haaththi dizaso ubbaa bolla ne kushe piddisa› ga; izi ba kushe piddisikko haaththi wuri suuththan laamettana; Gibxe biitta ubbaan, haray attoshin, miththafenne shuchchafe wooci kessida haath tigiza miishshata ubbaan suuththi kumana» gides.
Museynne Aarooney GODAY azazida mala ooththida. Kawoza sinththaninne daannata sinththan Aarooney ba guufeza denththidi shaafa haaththaa shociin haaththi wuri suuththan laamettides.
He shaafa haaththaa giddon diza moleti hayqqida; shaafa haaththi keehi xinqqida gishshas Gibxe asay uyanaas dandaybeenna. Gibxe biittay kumeth suuth xalla gidides.
Gido attiin Gibxe maroti ba biittan izaththoka ooththida; GODAY yootida malakka kawoza wozinay minnida gishshas Museynne Aarooney yootidayssa siyontta ixxides.
Hessafe guye kawozi hessas aykko babbontta dishe ba soo simmi bides.
Gibxe asay wuri Abbaye shaafa haaththaa uyanaas dandayontta gishshas, uyiza haath demmanaas Abbaye shaafaa achchan olla bookkida.
GODAY haaththaa suuththan laammiin laappun gallas gidides.
